mapper.select: SELECT t.title, t.description, t.price, t.category, t.level, t.total_score AS totalScore, t.average_rating AS averageRating, t.trainee_count AS traineeCount, e.progress, e.completed_at AS completedAt FROM trainings t JOIN enrollments e ON e.training_id = t.training_id WHERE t.training_id = #{trainingId} AND e.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT r.routine_id AS routineId, r.title AS name, rr.status AS completed, rr.awared_score AS rewardPoint, rr.submitted_at AS completedAt FROM routines r LEFT JOIN routine_results rr ON r.routine_id = rr.routine_id LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON rr.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE r.training_id = #{trainingId} AND e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.order_number
